# Correlated owner repair

The new source family is the OpenAI UniformKServer tree-rounding construction. TreeRounding.park keeps unassigned mass explicit, Rounded constrains both subtree totals and parked mass, and extended_star preserves old observables while coupling new choices. RoundingKernel.kernel_next and kernel_rounded state support and transition guarantees. These were read as source, not compiled or instantiated in the multiplication proof. The borrowed idea is to repair several assignments jointly while preserving exact marginals and charging parked mass; our deterministic finite repair is a separate construction, not the source randomized rounding theorem.

Sufficient finite repair rule: choose a set of complete pending-child bins and remove only the helper roles assigned to them. Reassign exactly those role identities among those bins. Each role keeps its invocation, local register and width. Require the new pending interval to contain that invocation, total width in each bin to remain within its rank, and every physical family in an invocation to have at most one whole helper and no active data wire. Repack all selected supports contiguously and charge the exact leftover rank. Then the resulting map satisfies the same abstract complete-owner allocation contract. Full physical charts still have to be regenerated and independently replayed against the selected local provider before this becomes a deliverable.

The executable screen enumerates simultaneous assignments of all roles of three selected bins, checks capacity, timeline and per-call collision constraints, and minimizes the complete contribution of the changed leftover ranks at the baseline exponent. No leftover rank is erased. Neutral-face moves are allowed in a separately recorded bounded screen to avoid mistaking a strict local minimum for a complete result.

The first native scan examined 200,000 bin triples and 225,394,867 recursion nodes. It accepted no strictly improving repair. This is only a bounded discovery outcome. The separate aggregate capacity screen leaves about 0.044 percent supplier headroom in this fixed architecture, which directs further effort toward genuinely changed local providers. Neither screen proves optimality or supplies a new kappa claim.

The separate 40-second neutral-face sweep accepted 120,911 cost-neutral moves and visited 2,135,369,213 recursive assignment nodes. Its final leftover histogram was unchanged: 3:3044, 5:3608, 7:92, 48:796. No new physical certificate was packaged from these neutral research maps.

The selected improvement instead comes from the kernel lane's rank-sector factorization. Its ordered residual widths are byte-for-byte equal as integers to the pair35 list. Thus the original literal owner map is reused unchanged, with a fresh source-bound operator replay. The local profile delta is -56 rank-1 calls -56 rank-5 calls +56 rank-6 calls, preserving rank mass and improving every moment with exponent strictly between zero and one, since 6^a < 1 + 5^a. The measured complete-profile supplier root is about 0.0014041822501567602 before exact assembly. This actual gain must not be attributed to our unsuccessful correlated repair route.
